# EmptyTrash references entries in its own subfolder snapshots

The patch changes only two EmptyTrash range bindings from a copied RefPtr value to const auto&. One reads child IDs before dispatch; the other runs synchronously within the success callback after a fresh local enumeration. The inspected GetSubFolders fills a caller-owned array, while PropagateDelete changes the live mSubFolders collection. No loop reference is captured for later use. This is a bounded copy/lifetime observation for these paths, not a universal reference rule, removal of all snapshot copies or measured performance result.

Scope: Exchange EmptyTrash loop bindings.
